subject: Your meeting room has a voice.
preheader: A 90-minute room review from Feltwork. Less echo. More conversation.

attrs.alt: Curved clay and oat wool-felt acoustic baffles hang above a sunlit oak meeting table.

content.text: If your meeting room keeps talking after everyone stops, start with the room.
Hard surfaces, layout and the way people use a space all shape how it sounds. We look at what is there, listen together and talk through practical ways to make conversations feel easier.
A 90-minute room review gives you a written shortlist of what to soften, move or add. No equipment to buy in advance. No one-size-fits-all panel pack.
For small offices and shared workspaces.
